ports.name: run
ports.docstring:
Scan ``scan_path`` and write the four review artefacts.

``repo_root`` (the deep-module-mapper root owning ``parser/``) must already
be on ``sys.path``.

ports.name: build_svg
ports.docstring: Render the architecture SVG from a ``metrics.compute_metrics`` payload.

ports.name: Digest
ports.docstring: The rendered digest plus which truncation level is in effect.

ports.name: build_digest
ports.docstring:
Build the deterministic lightweight digest for ``graph``.

Walks the truncation ladder until the rendered text fits ``total_chars``;
``Digest.truncation`` reports the level reached (``"none"`` if it already
fits).

ports.name: depth_score
ports.docstring: Return (level, ratio) for a module's public ports.

ports.name: score_color
ports.docstring: Traffic-light color token for a depth level (depthScore.ts scoreColor).

ports.name: is_production_module
ports.docstring: The set the review (metrics + diagram) covers exactly.

ports.name: strongly_connected_components
ports.docstring:
Return SCCs of the directed graph ``adj`` (Kosaraju, deterministic).

A full DFS on the reverse graph yields exactly the same SCC partition as
the Tarjan used by the old ``recompose/detect.ts``; members are sorted for
stable output.

ports.name: build_review_edges
ports.docstring:
Production-to-production edges, resolving ``__init__`` facade targets.

Input: every ``graph.edges`` whose source is a production module.

ports.name: compute_metrics
ports.docstring: Build the full ``metrics.json`` payload for one scan Graph.

ports.name: graph
ports.docstring:
Build a minimal parser-shaped Graph dict from simple specs.

``modules`` maps module id -> port line numbers.

ports.name: Collector
ports.docstring: Collects diagnostics during a scan; finalize() dedups and sorts.

ports.name: collect_dynamic_imports
ports.docstring: Detect ``__import__`` and ``importlib.import_module`` calls (D19/Q5).

ports.name: Resolution
ports.docstring: Outcome of resolving one import/reference against the index.

ports.name: collect_references
ports.docstring: Collect call / inheritance / annotation / decorator references.

ports.name: collect_local_names
ports.docstring: All names bound inside any function body (params, assignments, loop vars).

ports.name: collect_module_defs
ports.docstring: Module-level defined names (functions, classes, assignments).

ports.name: build_symbol_table
ports.docstring: Map bound names to module/symbol entries.

ports.name: resolve_reference
ports.signature: (ref, symbol_table, module_index, source_id, module_defs, locals_, module_ports) -> Resolution
ports.docstring: Resolve a call/inheritance/annotation/decorator reference (F3/F4).

ports.name: build_module_index
ports.docstring: Map dotted module name -> module id (relative path, posix separators).

ports.name: classify
ports.docstring: Return ``(kind, module_id)`` where kind is local | stdlib | third_party.

ports.name: extract_ports
ports.docstring: Extract public ports from a parsed module (top-level statements only).

ports.name: scan_codebase
ports.docstring:
Return a Graph dict matching the schema from issue #2 (5 top-level keys).

``exclude_dirs`` (default None) adds extra directory names (matched at any
depth) to the always-excluded ``EXCLUDED_DIRS`` set.

ports.name: Port
ports.docstring: A module's public connection surface: a function, class or export.

ports.name: Module
ports.docstring: One ``.py`` file = one module (D1).

ports.name: Edge
ports.docstring: A dependency edge between two modules.

ports.name: ExternalModule
ports.docstring: A third-party package that the codebase depends on.

ports.name: Diagnostic
ports.docstring: A parser note: dynamic import, unresolved symbol or parse error.

ports.name: Graph
ports.docstring: The full scan result.

ports.name: User
ports.docstring: A user account.

ports.name: save_user
ports.docstring: Persist a user to the database.

ports.name: no_return_annotation
ports.docstring: Function without a return annotation (F2 regression).

ports.name: Admin
ports.docstring: An admin user.

ports.name: Decorated
ports.docstring: A class decorated with a foreign attribute.

ports.name: annotate
ports.docstring: Annotate with an imported type.

ports.name: format_name
ports.docstring: Format a name for display.

ports.name: Formatter
ports.docstring: Formats things.

ports.name: use_builtins
ports.docstring: Call builtins; these must not become unresolved symbols (F3).

ports.name: use_submodule
ports.docstring: Call into the core submodule imported via `from sample_pkg import core`.
